originalTitle: Update: US Equity Indexes Mixed as Sell-Off in Technology Continues, Crude Oil Sinks Ahead of Midterm Elections

content: (Updates with index/price moves and company/geopolitical news from the first paragraph.) US equity indexes traded mixed as technology extended Friday's drubbing and crude oil plunged ahead of the midterm elections. The Nasdaq dropped 1.1% to 25,164.32, the S&P 500 fell 0.5% to 7,541.40, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.4% to 51,983.98 at the close on Monday. Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian said the country's supreme leader further empowered the government to pursue peace talks, as US President Donald Trump hinted at progress in negotiations a day before the midterm elections, Bloomberg reported Monday. The front-month West Texas Intermediate crude oil contract plummeted 7.5% to $96.32 per barrel, and global benchmark Brent plunged 8.1% to $104.27 per barrel. Energy and technology led decliners, while consumer discretionary, materials, and financials led the gainers. The iShares PHLX Semiconductor Exchange Traded Fund, with about $48.43 billion in assets under management, slumped 2.9%, reflecting heavy selling in chip manufacturing industry-related names. Of the 20 worst-performing stocks with market capitalization exceeding $200 billion each, 15 were technology companies and four energy firms at the close of trading, according to data compiled by Finviz. Intel (INTC), Oracle (ORCL), and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) declined the most, down by at least 7.5% each. In company news, Idexx Laboratories (IDXX) shares soared 22%, the top gainer on the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq, after reporting a jump in Q3 comparable earnings and revenue and raising its 2026 outlook. Marvell Technology (MRVL) has agreed to buy optical and photonic products maker Lumentum (LITE) in an all-stock deal worth about $115 billion, as the companies aim to create a leader in AI connectivity. Lumentum shares plunged 19%, and Marvell slumped 13%, the Nasdaq and S&P 500's worst performers. US Treasury yields were mixed, with the two-year up 1.7 basis points to 4.60%, the 10-year down 1.7 basis points to 4.91%, and the 30-year retreated 2.2 basis points to 5.29%. In economic news, the Institute for Supply Management's US manufacturing index rose to 55.5 in October from 54.5 in September, versus expectations for no change in a Bloomberg-compiled survey. The index has been above 50 in each of the first 10 months of 2026, despite the conflict with Iran, the uncertain status of the Strait of Hormuz, and resulting energy price volatility, according to a Jefferies note. "The report shows robust manufacturing activity, but the comments show widespread concerns about prices due to a host of factors." The S&P Global US manufacturing index for October was revised down to 54.9 from a flash reading of 56.0, compared with expectations for no revision in a survey compiled by Bloomberg. The October index now stands below 55.9 reported in September, indicating a slower pace of expansion. US construction spending fell 1.9% in September, down from the 0.3% increase expected in a Bloomberg survey and after a 2.0% rise in August.
chineseTitle: 更新：美国股指涨跌互现，科技股持续抛售，中期选举前原油下跌
chineseSummary: （第一段中的指数/价格走势和公司/地缘政治新闻更新。）
chineseContent: （更新第一段中的指数/价格变动和公司/地缘政治新闻。）美国股指涨跌互现，技术延续了周五的惨败，而中期选举前原油暴跌。周一收盘，纳斯达克指数下跌 1.1%，至 25,164.32 点，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.5%，至 7,541.40 点，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.4%，至 51,983.98 点。据彭博社周一报道，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安表示，伊朗最高领导人进一步授权政府进行和平谈判，而美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在中期选举前一天暗示谈判将取得进展。近月西德克萨斯中质原油合约暴跌 7.5%，至每桶 96.32 美元，全球基准布伦特原油合约暴跌 8.1%，至每桶 104.27 美元。能源和科技股领跌，而非必需消费品、材料和金融股领涨。管理资产约 484.3 亿美元的 iShares PHLX 半导体交易所交易基金下跌 2.9%，反映出芯片制造行业相关股票的大量抛售。 Finviz 汇编的数据显示，截至收盘时，在市值超过 2000 亿美元、表现最差的 20 只股票中，有 15 只是科技公司，四家是能源公司。英特尔 (INTC)、甲骨文 (ORCL) 和 Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 跌幅最大，各跌幅至少 7.5%。公司新闻方面，在报告第三季度可比盈利和收入大幅增长并上调 2026 年前景后，Idxx Laboratories (IDXX) 股价飙升 22%，成为标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数涨幅最大的股票。 Marvell Technology (MRVL) 已同意以价值约 1150 亿美元的全股票交易收购光学和光子产品制造商 Lumentum (LITE)，两家公司的目标是打造 AI 连接领域的领导者
